title: Hells Angels member hospitalized for weeks after the visit

tellings.quote: and he had checked himself into the hospital for weeks

plain: A member of the Hells Angels motorcycle club named Erik Bard is said to have checked himself into a hospital for weeks after a visit connected to Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange events. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells Michels this as something Bard told him, saying only that "he had checked himself into the hospital for weeks," without further detail of what happened.
